text:
alejandra: Quick heads-up — Hawkline private cutover: certs + KMS keys are DONE, but customer reported egress issue to telemetry.redwood.ai:443. They only allow specified NATs.

sam: who owns the NAT rule setup on our side? we have to coordinate with their infra and our edge team. @raj?

raj: I can take NAT coordination. Filed ticket HAWK-432 and pinged their infra lead. ETA EOD tomorrow for rule review. I need the list of IPs we need allowed (edge-prober + metrics-relay).

jin: FYI, during a dry run I saw the nomad job edge-prober fail after image sync. Logs:
```
2026-02-25T09:12:03Z ERR dial tcp 10.0.3.5:443: i/o timeout
2026-02-25T09:12:04Z WARN retrying (3/5)
```
Looks like egress is definitely blocked from their subnet.

michael: Can we provide them a short whitelist: 34.120.12.8/32 (edge-prober), 34.120.12.9/32 (metrics), 34.120.12.10/32 (bastion)? Also need to check outbound SNI passthrough for telemetry.redwood.ai.

tara: added SNI note to HAWK-432. Also, their SOC asked for FIPS mode verification on our TLS stacks. We should confirm the FIPS-compatible cert chain is used for the private bundle.

alejandra: Good catch. @michael can you confirm the cert chain used by the private bundle is FIPS-friendly? If not, we need a knob with the installer.

michael: Confirmed the bundle uses our FIPS cert chain when the installer flag `--use-fips` is set. Default installer doesn't enable it. We'll add a note to the runbook and patch the on-prem chart to allow `useFips: true` via values.

raj: re: image sync — their airgap registry requires SHA verification. Jin, can you add the `--image-digest-only` step to the sync job and post the snippet?

jin: snippet in case folks want to copy:
```
# image-sync job
skopeo copy --sign-by none --digest-algo sha256 docker://redwood/edge:1.2.0 dir:/sync/edge --format v2s2
sha256sum /sync/edge/manifest.json | awk '{print $1}' > /sync/edge/manifest.sha256
```
This will make the onprem install verify digest before starting.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: certs=ok, k8s-psp=blocked, image-sync=blocked, egress=blocked

sam: who owns k8s-psp/PodSecurity changes? that's blocking their acceptance tests.

tara: I can own the PSP change. Quick note — customer clusters are using strict PSP profiles; we'll need a short-lived exception or update to our helm charts to use the restricted profile. I'll open a PR today and ping for CR.

alejandra: PR pinged in #eng-releases once ready. Also need someone to sanity-check the HSM key policy: customer wants KMS-backed HSM with rotation window <24h.

raj: @michael / @jin can you validate rotation window? Our KMS integration supports daily rotation, but HSM provisioning lead time might complicate cutover.

michael: Our KMS supports rotation policy up to 1 hour granularity. For HSM provisioning, their vendor needs a 48h window to provision signed attestation. We should document that gap and set expectations with the customer.

sam: Action items summary:
- raj: NAT coord + update HAWK-432 with required IPs (ETA EOD)
- jin: add digest-only image-sync step + paste artifact (in progress)
- tara: PSP Helm chart PR and CR ping (ETA today)
- michael: patch installer for `useFips` + confirm KMS rotation policy doc (EOD)
- alejandra: send customer status email once NAT plan and PSP PR are green

raj: I'll also request a short public-IP failover test window from customer (15m) so we can validate egress and SNI.

jin: once NAT is open, runbook step to smoke test:
```
curl -v --resolve telemetry.redwood.ai:443:34.120.12.8 https://telemetry.redwood.ai/status
```
Expect HTTP 200 and a `x-rw-prober: ok` header.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2026-02-26T03:00Z pending all checks green.

alejandra: If PSP PR delays, we should fallback to enabling a temporary cluster exception and document the risk.

michael: noted. I'll draft the temporary-exception snippet for ops runbook.

sam: Thanks team — please update HAWK-432 with any new findings and drop quick status in this thread so I can relay to CS. :thumbsup:

raj: will update. closing for now, will re-open thread if anything blocks tomorrow.
